item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,449
item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,449 of Russia’s war on Ukraine.

item.title: US Energy Secretary Chris Wright touts oil production on Venezuela visit
item.description: Democrats introduce legislation to force Donald Trump's administration to be transparent about Venezuelan oil sales.

item.description: The vote was a rare rebuke against Trump from the Republican-led chamber, as Congress members face midterm elections.

item.description: Russia will operate only return flights from Cuba as 'evacuation' of tourists from Caribbean island gets under way.

item.title: Trump orders Pentagon to buy electricity generated by coal
item.description: Trump's order is the latest move by US administration to boost fossil fuel industry despite climate change concerns.

item.title: Two children killed in drone strike on mosque in central Sudan: Doctors
item.description: The Sudan Doctors Network said the deadly strike was carried out by the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces.

item.title: Why was El Paso airspace shut down? Drones, security fears and confusion
item.description: The FAA initially announced a 10-day airspace closure but removed the restriction less than eight hours later.

item.title: Epstein sought help of ex-Russian official linked to FSB, files show
item.description: Official with links to Russia's spy agency collected information on a woman to pass on to Epstein, emails show.

item.title: Children in Gaza forced to focus on work rather than school
item.description: Children in Gaza find themselves having to work to survive, sacrificing education and childhood dreams.

item.title: North Korea’s Kim Jong Un sets stage for daughter as his successor: Seoul
item.description: Little is known about Kim's daughter who made her first public appearance in 2022 but appears set to be successor.
